description: Fires after successful new account creation (email or Google OAuth). distinct_id = Supabase user UUID.
Fires after successful login of existing user (email or Google OAuth).
Fires immediately before posthog.reset() on logout.
Fires when a new user completes the onboarding flow.
Fires when a problem is rendered to the user.
Fires when user clicks the Solutions tab to reveal a problem's solution.
Fires when user submits an answer to a problem; includes correctness.
Fires when user bookmarks a problem from the problems list.
Fires when user removes a bookmark from the problems list.
Fires when an AI tutor session begins.
Fires when the user sends a message in a tutor session.
Server-side. Fires when the chat API handles an AI chat message. distinct_id propagated via X-POSTHOG-DISTINCT-ID header.
Fires when a mock interview session begins.
Fires when a mock interview session completes.
Fires when a PDF document is opened in the PDF viewer.
Fires when the newsletter (Substack) modal is opened. Substack iframe handles the subscription itself, so this is the latest client-side signal we have.
Fires when user selects a plan on the upgrade page (pre-checkout).
Fires when a user triggers checkout via startCheckout(). Captures plan_type and promo code presence.
Server-side. Fires when the Stripe checkout session is created.
Server-side. Fires on Stripe webhook checkout.session.completed.
Server-side. Fires from TWO sources: (1) user-initiated cancel via /api/subscription/cancel, and (2) Stripe webhook customer.subscription.deleted (final confirmation).
Server-side. Fires on Stripe webhook invoice.payment_succeeded.
Server-side. Fires on Stripe webhook invoice.payment_failed.
